questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

12, 14, 17, 22, 29, 40, ?
questions.solution:
Given series: 12, 14,17, 22, 29, 40, ?

The pattern followed here is,

The numbers are increasing in the order of prime numbers.

12 + 2 = 14

14 + 3 = 17

17 + 5 = 22

22 + 7 = 29

29 + 11 = 40

**40 + 13 = 53**

Hence, ‘53’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12
questions.solution:
**1) 6, 8**

**Given equation: 3 ****× 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12**

**After interchanging ‘6, 8’, we get:**

**L.H.S = 3 ****× 8 + 72 ÷ 6 - 24 **

**= 24 + 12 – 24**

**= 12 = R.H.S**

2) 24, 3

Given equation: 3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12

After interchanging ’24, 3’, we get:

L.H.S = 24 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 3

= 144 + 9 - 3

= 153 - 3

= 150 ≠ R.H.S

3) 72, 24

Given equation: 3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12

After interchanging ’72, 24’, we get:

L.H.S = 3 × 6 + 24 ÷ 8 - 72

= 18 + 3 - 72

= 21 - 72

= -51 ≠ R.H.S

4) 3, 8

Given equation: 3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12

After interchanging ‘3, 8’, we get:

L.H.S = 8 × 6 + 72 ÷ 3 - 24

= 48 + 24 - 24

= 48 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘6, 8’ is the correct answer

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I, II , III and IV Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All boys are experts.

2. Some experts are travelers.

3. All travelers are foreigners.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some foreigners are experts.

II. Some foreigners are boys.

III. No foreigner is boy.

IV. All travelers are experts.

options.text: Conclusion IV and Either II or III follows
Conclusion I, II and IV follow
Conclusion I and Either II or III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c174238e4b2350538c6b07767129f7f5e84a280c746795b76cea6efaeba855f.png] 

I. Some foreigners are experts. → True

II. Some foreigners are boys. → False (It is possible, but it is not definite)

III. No foreigner is boy. → False (It is possible, but it is not definite)

IV. All travelers are experts. → False (It is possible, but it is not definite)

But, conclusion II and III forms a complementary pair.

Hence, conclusion I and either II or III follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

.’Some’ is a subset of ‘All’. If in statements it is given that ‘All A are B’ then the conclusion ‘Some A are B’ would always be True.

questions.question: If B = 2 and P = 16, and BAT = 23, then CRICKET = _____.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06c01734f8aa4c011a0a36a57e3bea6aebf56189f0aedd590f9d0d65a852ad3.png] 

According to the positional values of the letters,

B = 2, P = 16 and

BAT → 2 + 1 + 20 = 23

Similarly,

CRICKET → 3 + 18 + 9 + 3 + 11 + 5 + 20 = 69

Hence, ‘69’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number on the same basis as the second number is related to the first number.

7 : 42 :: 9 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

7 : 42 → 7 : [7 × (7 – 1)]

Similarly,

9 : ? → 9 : [9 × (9 – 1)]

Or, ? = 72

Hence, ‘72’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: B, I, J, T, A and D are sitting around a round table facing the centre. D is to the right of I who is opposite of T, B is not next to J, who is to the right of T. Who is to the left of A?
questions.solution:
Given: B, I, J, T, A and D are sitting around a round table facing the centre.

1. D is to the right of I who is opposite of T, B is not next to J who is to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf3b320116b76d414f00cca737688a9a36c6080eaf12db58f393d9448f1df8b3.png] 

Hence, B will occupy the position between T and D, as it is the only position left for B.

Now, A is left, which will occupy position to the left of I.

So, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4780cd1427f4a33a34e69ed0f7b3127c922afb9b12554ab722225f4c53bf6d7f.png]
